name: gothic
units: 1 unit = 1 stud (OBJ exported Y-up, -Z forward via Blender's wm.obj_export)

pieces.name: wall_plain
pieces.desc: 8w x 16h x 4d wall, bevel, top trim band + base kick

pieces.name: wall_window
pieces.desc: 8w x 16h x 4d wall, pointed-arch window + inset frame ring (0.2 proud of face)

pieces.name: wall_doorway
pieces.desc: 8w x 16h x 4d wall, round-top doorway + U frame (0.2 proud of face)

pieces.name: merlon_run
pieces.desc: 24w parapet: base band + 8 crenel blocks (2x2x1.5, pitch 3)

pieces.name: buttress
pieces.desc: foot column 6x16x8 + flying strut + pinnacle + pyramid cap

pieces.name: corner_tower
pieces.desc: 16-dia x 32h cylinder + crown ring + 12 rim crenels

pieces.name: stair_run
pieces.desc: 8 solid steps, 2 rise x 3 tread, lowest step at front

pieces.name: arch_large
pieces.desc: two 4x20x4 columns, 16 gap, peaked apex (~40 deg wedges)

pieces.name: gate_frame
pieces.desc: 24w x 28h gatehouse face, 10w x 14h portcullis arch + jamb ring, 2 flanking 6x24x6 towers, merlons

pieces.name: spire_cap
pieces.desc: 4 stacked cylinders 12/10/8/4 dia x ~8h + pyramid tip
